svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT Y field guide
svg.desc: Agent Y takes one explicitly assigned task through a selected installed CLI and returns bounded branch or PR evidence.
svg.text: One selected CLI task and a bounded PR handoff
Prepare one assigned task for an installed CLI.
Return branch or PR evidence; do not merge.
Agent Y uses a selected CLI under host permissions.
A draft PR grants no merge or task-acceptance authority.
